versions.author: designer
versions.summary:
Lanterns on your units send enemy attacks onto the attacker's own side.
You place the lights, then cash in what went wrong for them: gold, buffs and stats from drowned enemies.

versions.author: reviser
versions.summary:
Lost now counts every misled attack, the Reflection doubles both sides of a misled hit, and a misled attack with nobody else to hit strikes itself.
Stingy Jack now costs 2 gold per Turnip, since banked gold was free, and Captain Spunkie gives free Refreshes at Tier 6.

stop_reason: 2 of 3 reviewers said it's in a good spot
